title: Pear and Jerusalem Artichoke Pappardelle
subtitle: with butter and pink peppercorns
description: Pappardelle tossed with buttery Jerusalem artichokes and pear wedges and finished with crushed pink peppercorns. Black pepper works if you have no pink.

steps.text: Melt the butter in a heavy pan, add the thinly sliced Jerusalem artichokes and 1/2 cup water, season with salt, cover and cook on low heat for about 10 minutes until they begin to soften. Uncover and cook for 3 to 4 more minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the pappardelle according to the packet instructions and drain.
Add the peeled, cored and sliced pears to the pan, raise the heat to high and cook for 2 minutes. Add the pappardelle and toss gently.
Transfer to plates and sprinkle with crushed pink peppercorns.
